summary:
**COSMIC CURE – Astronaut Health Monitoring System**

COSMIC CURE is an integrated astronaut health monitoring system designed to support astronauts during space missions. It combines hardware and software to bring important health and mission information together in one easy-to-use dashboard.

The hardware uses an ESP32 connected to sensors, including MAX30102 for heart rate, DS18B20 for temperature, and DHT11 for ambient temperature. The website provides four main features: Health Analytics to review health readings and trends, Alerts Center to display notifications based on configured thresholds, Mission Location & Communication to show location details and estimated communication delay, and Health Assessment to provide a guided health check.

The platform also includes AI movement tracking using MediaPipe, sleep monitoring, and stress check-ins. What makes COSMIC CURE special is combining these tools in one organized system.

Our goal is to make astronaut health information easier to monitor, understand, and review. Future improvements include connecting validated sensors, improving movement tracking, and enhancing alerts and reports. COSMIC CURE is a prototype that demonstrates how technology can support astronaut health and well-being during space exploration.
details:
COSMIC CURE – Project Details

Astronaut Health Monitoring System

COSMIC CURE is an integrated health monitoring system designed to support astronauts during space missions. Space environments can affect astronauts' physical and mental well-being due to microgravity, sleep disturbances, stress, and isolation.

Our project combines hardware and software in one platform to make health information easier to monitor and review.

Hardware Components:

  • ESP32 microcontroller to connect sensors and transfer readings.
  • MAX30102 sensor for heart rate measurement.
  • DS18B20 sensor for temperature measurement.
  • DHT11 sensor for ambient temperature measurement.

Software Features:

  • Health Analytics: Organizes health readings, trends, sleep, stress, and movement records.
  • Alerts Center: Displays notifications based on configured thresholds.
  • Mission Location & Communication: Shows mission location information and estimated communication delays.
  • Health Assessment: Provides a guided, rule-based health check.
  • AI Movement Monitoring: Uses MediaPipe and camera-based pose tracking.
  • Sleep & Stress Monitoring: Allows users to record sleep duration and stress levels.

Innovation:

COSMIC CURE brings multiple astronaut health and mission tools together in one dashboard instead of using separate platforms. It combines sensor technology, computer vision, health analytics, and mission information in one organized system.

Expected Impact:

The project aims to help astronauts and mission teams review health-related information more easily and understand changes during space missions. It demonstrates how technology can support astronaut well-being during long-duration space exploration.

Future Development:

Future improvements include connecting validated sensors, improving movement tracking, enhancing alerts and reports, and strengthening data privacy.

Current Limitations:

Some readings may be simulated or manually entered. Movement labels are experimental, and the current ESP32 setup does not provide live SpO₂ readings. COSMIC CURE is a prototype, not a certified medical device.
